# Recommended VS Code / Cursor Extensions

This document lists all extensions currently installed for the Memento project. Team members can use this list to install the same extensions for consistency.

## Quick Install

Copy and paste this command in your terminal to install all extensions:

```bash
code --install-extension alefragnani.bookmarks
code --install-extension anysphere.cursorpyright
code --install-extension christian-kohler.path-intellisense
code --install-extension dbaeumer.vscode-eslint
code --install-extension denoland.vscode-deno
code --install-extension donjayamanne.githistory
code --install-extension dracula-theme.theme-dracula
code --install-extension eamodio.gitlens
code --install-extension esbenp.prettier-vscode
code --install-extension formulahendry.auto-rename-tag
code --install-extension gruntfuggly.todo-tree
code --install-extension mechatroner.rainbow-csv
code --install-extension mhutchie.git-graph
code --install-extension ms-python.debugpy
code --install-extension ms-python.python
code --install-extension ms-vscode.brackets-keybindings
code --install-extension ms-vscode.brackets-pack
code --install-extension openai.chatgpt
code --install-extension pkief.material-icon-theme
code --install-extension pranaygp.vscode-css-peek
code --install-extension ritwickdey.liveserver
code --install-extension shalldie.background
code --install-extension usernamehw.errorlens
code --install-extension vscode-icons-team.vscode-icons
code --install-extension wix.vscode-import-cost
code --install-extension zhuangtongfa.material-theme
code --install-extension zignd.html-css-class-completion
```

## Essential Extensions for This Project

**Must-have** for Memento project:

- ✅ Prettier (`esbenp.prettier-vscode`)
- ✅ ESLint (`dbaeumer.vscode-eslint`)
- ✅ Error Lens (`usernamehw.errorlens`)
- ✅ GitLens (`eamodio.gitlens`)
- ✅ Material Icon Theme (`pkief.material-icon-theme`)
- ✅ Background (`shalldie.background`) - For project watermark

**Recommended**:

- Path Intellisense (`christian-kohler.path-intellisense`)
- Auto Rename Tag (`formulahendry.auto-rename-tag`)
- Todo Tree (`gruntfuggly.todo-tree`)
- Import Cost (`wix.vscode-import-cost`)

## Installation via VS Code UI

1. Open VS Code / Cursor
2. Press `Cmd+Shift+X` (Mac) or `Ctrl+Shift+X` (Windows/Linux) to open Extensions
3. Search for each extension by name or ID
4. Click "Install"

## Installation via Command Line

For VS Code:

```bash
code --install-extension <extension-id>
```

For Cursor:

```bash
cursor --install-extension <extension-id>
```

## Extension Settings

See `.vscode/settings.json` for recommended extension configurations.

## Notes

- Some extensions may have different versions available
- Python extensions are optional unless working with Python code
- Deno extension is optional unless using Deno runtime
- AI extensions (ChatGPT) are optional and may require API keys
- Theme extensions are personal preference - choose one or install all
